final_netlist:
.subckt dut vin vout vref vss ibias
* ---- reference level shift: vrh(=ibias node) = VREF + IREF*40k = 1.00 V (exact)
Rsh   ibias vref 40k

* ---- bias generator (resistor from vin -> NMOS diode) and tail mirror
RB    vin   nb    61286.1
MB    nb    nb    vss  vss  nfet W=6.10262 L=3.43552
MT    tail  nb    vss  vss  nfet W=9.72711 L=3.43552

* ---- error amplifier: NMOS pair (CM ~1.0 V), PMOS mirror load
* M1 (diode side) <- feedback, M2 (output side) <- shifted reference
M1    nd    fbh   tail vss  nfet W=12.6596 L=0.827671
M2    g     ibias tail vss  nfet W=12.6596 L=0.827671
M3    nd    nd    vin  vin  pfet W=50.69 L=0.577588
M4    g     nd    vin  vin  pfet W=50.69 L=0.577588

* ---- pass device
MP    vout  g     vin  vin  pfet W=1000.31 L=0.338875

* ---- compensation
RZ    g     cz    20909.8
CC    cz    vout  1.56246e-10
CGV   g     vin   1.93171e-12
CFF   vout  fbh   8.85688e-11

* ---- feedback divider: vout = vfb * 6/5 = 1.2 V  (ratio fixed by unit resistors)
R1    vout  fbh   95907.6
R2a   fbh   d1    95907.6
R2b   d1    d2    95907.6
R2c   d2    d3    95907.6
R2d   d3    d4    95907.6
R2e   d4    vss   95907.6
.ends dut
